themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can perform complex research tasks autonomously or with minimal human intervention, including data analysis, summarization, and strategy generation.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools that assist developers and researchers in writing, debugging, and optimizing code, including AI code generation and refactoring.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Explores the use of AI to create artificial user profiles or data for testing, research, and simulation purposes.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Highlights a broad range of AI-powered tools and platforms designed to enhance research processes, from data gathering to analysis.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles focusing on AI's ability to condense large amounts of text, such as research papers, meeting transcripts, or articles, into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI design & prototyping
themes.description: Covers AI applications in the design process, including AI-assisted UI/UX design, prototyping, and generating design assets.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI is affecting job roles, skill requirements, and the overall labor market, with a focus on research and development.

themes.name: AI qualitative research
themes.description: Focuses on AI's application in qualitative research methods, such as analyzing open-ended responses, interviews, or user feedback.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: Discusses how AI is being used to support product managers in tasks like opportunity identification, strategy development, and user feedback analysis.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Articles that compare and evaluate different AI tools for research, highlighting their features, benefits, and drawbacks.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
